lines.text: Jesus says He is going to prepare a place in His Father's house and will come back for them.
Thomas says they do not know the way, and Jesus says He is the way, the truth, and the life.
Andrew asks Jesus to show them the Father, and Jesus says anyone who has seen Him has seen the Father.
Jesus says the Father will give them another Advocate, the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive.
Judas, not Iscariot, asks why Jesus reveals Himself to them, and Jesus says They will make a throne with him.
